title: Discovering action verbs
summary: Recognise Spanish verbs for everyday actions.
keyIdeas: Many verbs describe actions, such as correr, leer and cantar. Others describe states, such as ser and estar.
To recognise an action verb, ask what someone does.
In these examples, the verb tells us what a person or animal does.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas la producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: Which Spanish word names an action you can do?
activities.explanation: «Saltar» is an action you can do with your body. «Mesa» names an object and «azul» names a colour.
activities.hint: Think of something you can do at break time.

activities.prompt: In the Spanish sentence «Omar come una manzana», «come» is a verb.
Sort these Spanish words by whether they name an action or an object.
activities.explanation: «Escribir» and «Dormir» name things we can do. «Lápiz» and «Balón» name objects we can touch.

activities.prompt: Choose the Spanish verb to complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: «pinta» is the verb naming Aisha's action.
activities.sentence: Aisha ___ un dibujo muy bonito para su abuela.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish person or animal phrase to its action.
activities.explanation: «vuela», «prepara» and «juegan» are verbs that tell us what each subject does.

activities.prompt: Which word is the verb in «Hugo corre por el patio»?
activities.explanation: «corre» is the verb because it tells us what Hugo does.
activities.hint: Find the word naming Hugo's action.

activities.prompt: Lucía wakes up first, then has breakfast, then walks to school. Put her morning actions in order using the Spanish phrases.
activities.explanation: Lucía's routine is waking up, having breakfast and walking to school.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish text carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: «montar», «saltar», «lanzar» and «reír» are action verbs used in this text in different forms.
activities.title: Tarde en el parque
activities.text: Martina y Wei van al parque de su barrio. Martina monta en patinete con cuidado. Wei lanza la pelota a su perra Chispas. Chispas salta muy alto y atrapa el balón. Los dos amigos ríen contentos.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish phrase names Martina's action in the park?
questions.explanation: The text says that Martina rides a scooter: «Martina monta en patinete».

questions.prompt: Which Spanish verb says what Chispas does before catching the ball?
questions.explanation: The text says that Chispas jumps very high: «Chispas salta muy alto».

activities.prompt: Which Spanish phrase has no verb?
activities.explanation: «El perro grande y marrón» has no verb telling us what the dog does. The other sentences have «lee» and «nada».
activities.hint: Find the phrase that does not say what anyone does.

activities.prompt: Lucía helps in the school library. Which Spanish sentence clearly describes her action?
activities.explanation: «ordena» is the verb describing Lucía's action in the library.
activities.hint: Find the sentence with a verb telling us what Lucía does.
options: Lucía ordena los libros en las estanterías.
